name: Fractera Design
summary: The design of the project as its own element: colours, fonts, type, shapes and block settings live here, the architect edits them here, and every element of the node re-styles itself the moment they are saved.

port.note: A wish, not a decision. The node assigns the actual port from the block 24680-24699. Ask the node, never remember.

runtime.note: server.js is the service (node:http). `npm run build` = the route guard + the site (presentation/, Next 16 Cache Components) into the folder NEXT_DIST_DIR names; `.presentation-dist` marks it. Pages are data folders in presentation/content (skill use-page-tree).

api.format: JSON: { ok, kind, defaults, patch, config } — config = the owner patch over the defaults

doors.gives: the public home page of the element
search signals; the sitemap lists pages only once the element has a real public address
MCP: the project design as commands for an agent
the project design: the key X-Settings-Key (every element of the node) or the architect session
write a patch — only the architect (session through the sign-in service); the key does not give writing
whether the viewer is the architect — for the screens of the architect mode

languages.note: The public home page speaks en and ru.

settings.store: data/settings/design.json (the owner patch; defaults in settings/design/defaults.json)
settings.seed: node scripts/seed-from-site.mjs <site folder> — once, at the birth of the element; never overwrites
settings.note: The SOURCE of the project design for the whole node (step 309). Every element subscribes and re-styles itself on the signal.
